name: UGC 3459 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 3459, a low surface brightness galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc3459-hubble
story: A massive galaxy of the dim, low surface brightness kind. Hubble searched it for globular clusters, dense collections of old stars, at a time when no globular cluster study of such galaxies had been reported.

claims.text: UGC 3459 is a target of Hubble program 10550 on low surface brightness (LSB) galaxies and their globular clusters
The program's sample is massive low surface brightness galaxies imaged with ACS in F475W and F775W
No globular cluster study had been reported for LSB galaxies at the time
Globular clusters are dense collections of older stars
